AGENDA
  GLENDALE AUDIT COMMITTEE
  MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING
  633 E. Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.
  OCTOBER 30, 2025 AT 2:00 PM

1.  ROLL CALL

2.  BUSINESS AGENDA
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the October 30, 2025 Audit Committee Meeting was posted on October 23,
  2025, on the bulletin board outside City Hall.

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed 3 minutes.
  The Committee may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or
   decision. The Audit Committee Chair may refer the matter to staff for investigation and report.

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  a. Minutes of the Audit Committee Meeting held on July 31, 2025

5.  ACTION ITEMS
  a. Election of Audit Committee Chair
  1. Motion to select Chair for the term of October 2025 to July 2026.
  b.  Selection of External Auditor – Jack Liang, Director of Finance
  1. Motion to approve and recommend to City Council selecting Eide Bailly LLP to be the
  City’s external auditor to perform the annual audit of the financial records of the City
  for fiscal years ending 2025-26 through 2027-28, with the option to renew the contract
  for an additional three fiscal years.
  c.  Consideration of Request to Agendize Discussion on the Frequency of Audit
  Committee Meetings
  1. Motion to approve the request to agendize a discussion regarding the frequency of
  Audit Committee meetings at the next regular meeting.

6.  REPORTS - INFORMATION
  a. Internal Audit Activity Report as of September 30, 2025 – Natalie Minami-Valdivia,
  Principal Internal Auditor

7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS

8.  NEW BUSINESS

9.  ADJOURNMENT

CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  October 30, 2025

1.  ROLL CALL: 2:02 PM

  Present:  Zareh Davidian, Jack Mavyan, Denise Miller, Christopher
  Satoorian, Alex Parajon

  Absent:  None

2.  BUSINESS AGENDA:

  a. Posting of Agenda

  The Agenda for the Audit Committee meeting of October 30, 2025, was
  posted on October 23, 2025, on the bulletin board outside City Hall.

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  Speaker:  Andre Ordubegian, Herbert Molano, Ejmin Hakobian

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

  a. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on July 31, 2025

  Speaker: Ejmin Hakobian, Herbert Molano

  Moved:  Denise Miller  Seconded:  Jack Mavyan

  Vote as follows:

  Ayes:  Zareh Davidian, Jack Mavyan, Denise Miller, Christopher
  Satoorian, Alex Parajon
  Noes:  None
  Absent: None
  Abstain: None

5.  ACTION ITEMS:

  a. Election of Audit Committee Chair

  1
   Speaker: Ejmin Hakobian, Herbert Molano

  Committee Member Christopher Satoorian nominated Committee Member
  Alex Parajon.

  Vote as follows:

  Ayes:  Zareh Davidian, Jack Mavyan, Denise Miller, Christopher
  Satoorian, Alex Parajon
  Noes:  None
  Absent: None
  Abstain: None

b. External Auditor Selection – Jack Liang, Director of Finance

  Mr. Jack Liang, Director of Finance, gave an overview of the Request for
  Proposal (RFP) process and introduced Ms. Shu-Jun Li, Assistant Director of
  Finance, who presented further details of the RFP process and the result.
  Finance staff sent out an RFP to 15 accounting firms and received five
  responses. An External Auditor Selection Committee was formed which
  included City staff and the Audit Committee Chair, Mr. Alex Parajon. The top
  three Audit firms were interviewed and Eide Bailly, LLP was recommended by
  the Selection Committee to be the City’s External Auditor.

  Ms. Li introduced Mr. David Showalter, Partner at Eide Bailly, LLP, who
  subsequently presented the firm’s qualifications and answered questions from
  the Committee members.

  A motion was made to approve and recommend to City Council Eide Bailly,
  LLP as the City’s next External Auditor.

  Moved:  Jack Mavyan  Seconded:  Zareh Davidian

  Vote as follows:

  Ayes:  Zareh Davidian, Jack Mavyan, Denise Miller, Christopher
  Satoorian, Alex Parajon
  Noes:  None
  Absent: None
  Abstain: None

c. Consideration of Request to Agendize Discussion on the Frequency of
  Audit Committee Meetings

  Speaker: Ejmin Hakobian, Herbert Molano

  2
   No motion was made to agendize discussion of the frequency of Audit
  Committee Meetings.

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION:

  a. Internal Audit Activity Report as of September 30, 2025 – Natalie
  Minami-Valdivia, Principal Internal Auditor

  Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Principal Internal Auditor, provided a report to
  the Audit Committee on the Internal Audit activity for the quarter ended on
  September 30, 2025.

  Mr. Daniel Mitchell, Internal Auditor, made a presentation on the Public
  Benefits Program Audit and answered questions from the Committee
  members.

  After the audit presentation, Ms. Minami-Valdivia continued presenting the
  Internal Audit activity report for the quarter. She covered projects in progress,
  continuous audits, quarterly follow-up status on outstanding audit issues,
  outstanding priority one audit items, and outstanding audit items meeting
  Audit Committee discussion criteria.

  Ms. Minami-Valdivia introduced Dr. Suzie Abajian, City Clerk, and Kimberly
  Solorio, Records Administration Analyst, to address the outstanding audit
  items meeting Audit Committee discussion criteria. Dr. Abajian answered
  questions from the Committee members.

  Ms. Minami-Valdivia continued presenting the advisory services performed by
  the Internal Audit team.

  Speaker: Herbert Molano

7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS:

  None.

8.  NEW BUSINESS:

  Speaker:  Ejmin Hakobian

9.  ADJOURNMENT:

  Adjournment at 4:12 PM.
